text:
amelia: seeing 503s and throttle spikes from eu-central dedicated pool starting ~10:05 UTC. clients report higher latency and some fallbacks to hosted variants.
amelia: graph shows queue depth jump and fairshare evictions rising. dashboard link: https://dash.internal/redwood/eu-central/pool/metrics
ops-oncall: on it. are we seeing a recent rollout? deploy-bot: new config applied by raj at 09:58 UTC: 
```
PATCH /api/pools/eu-central
{"max_inflight": 1200, "burst_capacity": 0.15}
```
raj: that patch was to tighten burst to control costs for a single tenant that spiked last week. shouldn't have caused admission issues but maybe interaction with autoscaler.
lina: autoscaler logs show scale-up jobs failing with: "insufficient quota: allocation rejected by cloud-provider" x12 around 10:02.
kevin: cloud console shows GPU quota exhausted in eu-central-1 by partner accounts, quota request pending. support ticket #78912.
amelia: ok so we lost ability to add new nodes -> queue growth -> fairshare started evicting lower priority reservations -> throttles. we need an immediate mitigation.
ops-oncall: short-term options: 1) temporarily increase per-tenant weight for critical customers, 2) open fallback routing to other region (eu-west) for new requests, 3) enable hosted burst for non-sensitive traffic.
raj: pushing option 3 now: enable hosted burst routing for pool eid=eu-central with policy triggers for queue>400. deploying...
deploy-bot: routing change deployed at 10:19 UTC.
infra-bot: note: routing to hosted adds extra token cost, will be billed to the pool owner.
lina: monitoring: queue depth dropping within 3 min, latency for critical customers back to normal. non-critical still throttled but being served by hosted.
kevin: can we lift the tightened burst cap (the 0.15) as well? that would allow local admission without needing new nodes.
raj: I can revert that patch but cloud quota still a blocker for sustained throughput. reverting now.
deploy-bot: revert applied at 10:32 UTC.
ops-oncall: post-mitigation plan: 1) escalate quota with cloud (contact assigned), 2) review burst_policy interaction with autoscaler in stress tests, 3) temp doc to inform sales/CS about potential extra hosted costs.
amelia: filing incident ticket and assigning postmortem. immediate action saved SLA for priority customers but we should own the whole flow.
kevin: adding action: add early-warning alert when cloud-gpu-quota < 10% and queue growth delta > 200 in 5m.
lina: capturing logs and attaching kube events, autoscaler traces to the ticket.
raj: postmortem volunteers? I'll own the rollback/playbook writeup. lina and kevin can co-author on alerting and quota runbook.
ops-oncall: note: no customer-facing incident page yet; CS notified of temporary degraded behaviour for some non-critical tenants.
amelia: thanks folks, keep updates here. will schedule 1hr follow-up in 30m to confirm quota status and next steps. :thumbsup:
